text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ～ん？　
ふぅーん……
ふ～～～～ん……♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hey, Newbie Big Bro~ Do you even realize what you're saying? It basically means, "I'm just a weak, pathetic little loser who can't live without my beloved Fubuki-chan", right~♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
ザコお兄さんさ～、
自分で言ってる意味
わかってる？
「ザコザコでよわよわな僕は、
大好きなフブキちゃんがいないと
生きていけませぇ～ん」
ってことだよね～♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Eh? You never said that? Kyahaha, you're trying so hard to deny it, that's sooo lame♪ But, like, your true feelings are already totally obvious, Newb Big Bro. You can act all tough with your words, but deep down, your soul just wants to lose to Fubuki-chan, doesn't it~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
そんなの言ってない？　
きゃははっ、
必死すぎてだっさ♪
でもさー、
ザコお兄さんのホンネって
もうバレバレなんだよね。
口では強がってても、
魂がフブキちゃんに負けたがってる～
みたいなぁ？

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Your face? Your mannerisms? Your aura? You just reek of total newbie vibes from head to toe♪ You're sooo hopeless♡ Aww, you're starting to look so pitiful, I almost feel sorry for you♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
顔？　
挙動？　
オーラ？　
そういうのからぜーんぶ、
ザコザコな匂いが染み出ちゃってるもん♪　
ホントなっさけなーい♡
あーあ、
見ててかわいそーになってきちゃった♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: And then, you go and say something like "please let me devote my whole self to you, Fubuki-chan"? Even a guy like you has his uses, and you actually have been pretty helpful, too. So maybe, juuuust maybe, I might grant your wish as a little reward~...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんでぇ、
フブキちゃんにすべてを捧げさせてくださ～い、
だっけ？
お兄さんでもいちおー使いどころはあるし、
実際役には立ってるし？
ゴホービに、
お願い聞いてあげなくもないかなー
って思ったり～……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: ...Juuuust kidding! Pffft! Did you actually get your hopes up? There's no "reward" for a pathetic weakling like you~♡ If you want to ask me for something, you should be groveling a lot more shamelessly...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──なーんて、
ぷぷ～っ！　
本気で期待しちゃった？
よわよわザコザコお兄さんにゴホービなんてありませ～ん♡
ぼくにお願いしたいなら、
もっとみっともなく頭下げたりさー……

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? No, wait... Onii-san, what's this now?! Is that really allowed at this stage? No way, right?! Wait, don't try to casually slip away! Hey, don't ignore me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は……？　
いや、
ちょっと……
お兄さん何言ってんの！？
ここまで来てそんなのアリなの？　
ないっしょ！？
待って、
さりげなくどっか行こーとすんな！　
ねぇ
無視すんな～！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Aaah, fine, I get it! I'll grant your request! It really ticks me off that a total newbie like you has the nerve to be so cheeky, but I'll go ahead and face you properly! Wow, Fubuki-chan is just so kind!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
もー
わかった！　
お兄さんのお願い聞いたげる！
ザコお兄さんのくせにナマイキなのめちゃくちゃムカつくけど、
ちゃんと戦ってあげるし！　
わー
フブキちゃんやさし～っ！

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... Y-You're a good boy for actually listening to what I say, aren't you? That's more like it, Onii-san. I mean, going against my orders was never an option for you, was it? No way you could do that♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
はー、
はー……
ちゃ、
ちゃんとゆーこと聞けて偉いじゃん？
やっぱお兄さんはそーでなくっちゃだよね～
ぼくの命令に逆らうとかありえない
っつーか、
ムリでしょ♡

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I said no! Ugh, none of that stuff! You're gonna help me smash that shitty lizard-bitch! Right, it's decided! No objections allowed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
ダメだってば！　
もー、
そーゆーのなし！
お兄さんはぼくと一緒に
クソトカゲ女をぶっとばすの！
ハイけってーい♪　
異論は認めませーん♪

text_block_list.name: Fubuki
text_block_list.text: Be-si-des♡ Once it's all over, I'll make you Fubuki-chan's slave for life♪ So you'd better be ready, O·n·i·i·s·a·n♡
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ・
ん・
でー♡
終わったらぁ、
一生フブキちゃんのドレーにしたげるから♪
覚悟しといてね、
お・
に・
い・
さ・
ん♡
